author: GameTrailers
description: Get your first glimpse of gameplay from the upcoming first-person horror game Black Lake, in which you search for your missing twin sister inside an abandoned orphanage lost at sea. It's in development for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4928600/Black_Lake/
title: Black Lake - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Kungfupunk. Sanguine under fire. Check out the Delta Force × Phantom Blade Zero trailer for this crossover between the competitive Operator-based extraction shooter and the action RPG. The crossover brings Sanguine, a crossover-exclusive Legendary Melee Weapon Appearance. The Delta Force × Phantom Blade Zero crossover launches on November 10, 2026.
title: Delta Force × Phantom Blade Zero - Official Crossover Trailer
